svg.text: Each column is one DMA instruction from the workload; highlighted cell shows selected DMA queue.
Policy shown here: ACC MVIN/MVOUT fixed to DMA1; SPM MVIN balanced across DMA2/3; SPM MVOUT may borrow DMA1.
